name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
description: A government-backed framework for providing credit support to eligible micro and small business activities through participating lending institutions.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the lending institution and applicable scheme guidelines.
Business activity should fall within eligible micro or small enterprise activities.
application_method: Through participating banks, NBFCs or other eligible lending institutions.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
description: A programme supporting eligible applicants in establishing new micro enterprises through a credit-linked subsidy mechanism.
eligibility: Applicable eligibility conditions must be satisfied.
The enterprise must meet the current PMEGP guidelines.
Certain project and applicant conditions apply.
application_method: Application is made through the official PMEGP e-portal and participating implementing agencies/banks.

name: Stand-Up India
description: A scheme intended to facilitate bank loans for eligible women and SC/ST entrepreneurs setting up eligible new enterprises.
eligibility: Applicant must satisfy the current scheme eligibility conditions.
The enterprise must meet applicable requirements for a new business.
Bank-level assessment and scheme conditions apply.
application_method: Through participating banks and the official Stand-Up India platform.

name: Udyam Registration
description: The official registration system for eligible Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises in India.
eligibility: Enterprise must satisfy the applicable MSME classification requirements.
Registration information must be provided accurately.
application_method: Online through the official Udyam Registration portal.
